0.original: <hex:024804F201FC03><hex:024904F201FD03> Quest Sync<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>This bashful bowman could do with some advice.

48.original: I realize this is sudden, but would you lend me your ear for a moment? I would rather keep this secret from the others if possible.

49.original: I mean to propose to my beloved, and everything needs to be perfect, right down to where I spring the question.

50.original: Being what I presume to be a worldly traveler, I thought perhaps you could give me your opinion on the view from a few places I had in mind.

51.original: Good, good. My first choice was a quaint little place to the north. Follow me.

52.original: What do you think? I thought the view of Yx'Maja might set the mood.

53.original: A pity we can only view it from afar. I've heard the flowers there are quite beautiful, but the woods there are fiercely guarded.

54.original: Aha, that's it! “My dear, sweet beloved. Let me be the guardian to your ruins of Ronka, now and forevermore.”<hex:02100103>Do you think she would accept such a proposal?

55.original: No...? Well, I will give it some thought. Come, let me show you another spot near Lake Tusi Mek'ta.

56.original: Is the view of the lake not breathtaking?

57.original: At its bottom rests the Covered Halls of Dwatl, one of several ruins of the Ronkan Empire.

58.original: Ah! I have it now! “The ruin that is your love has sunk to the bottom of my heart. And there it shall remain for all time.”<hex:02100103>The perfect proposal, don't you think?

59.original: No, you're right. The wording could use a little work. Perhaps my third choice of location will prove inspirational.

60.original: This is perhaps my favorite of the three. Simple, quiet, and peaceful.

61.original: Hmmm... Perhaps that is all I need to propose─a simple expression of my love.

62.original: I realize there is much to consider, so you needn't give me your opinion now. Let us give it due thought while we return to Slitherbough.

63.original: Thank goodness you're here. The more I think on it, the more uncertain I become. Tell me, which place do you think would help me win her heart?

65.original: I think the view of Yx'Maja would be best.

66.original: The view from the edge of the lake was quite lovely.

67.original: The calm and quiet at the lake's center would be perfect.

68.original: I suppose there is a certain charm to that place. All right, that is where I'll propose.

69.original: It was, wasn't it? And there'd be no risk of falling in if we remain at its edge. All right, that is where I'll propose.

70.original: The center of the lake, eh? There would be nothing to distract me from telling her how I truly feel. All right, that is where I'll propose.

71.original: I was right to call upon you. What better place than that to offer her my true name.

72.original: ...Are you not familiar with the custom? Only immediate family should know one's true name. It's the only way to protect our hearts from the Light.

73.original: Which is why revealing one's name to another is of such great significance. Though I suspect my choice of words in proposing may yet sour the moment.

74.original: But don't you worry. When the time is right, I'm certain the words will flow freely.
